item_summary: $150-250 active noise-canceling over-ear wireless headphones with multipoint connectivity and a boom microphone for remote work
detailed_item_draft: Search specification for premium over-ear wireless headphones priced strictly between $150 and $250 USD. Primary use case is remote work requiring high-fidelity Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) to reduce ambient distraction. Connectivity must support Bluetooth multipoint pairing allowing simultaneous connection to two devices (e.g., laptop and phone). Key distinguishing feature: must include a dedicated boom microphone (fold-out or detachable arm) optimized for voice clarity in video conferencing, distinct from standard embedded mic arrays. Battery life requirement: minimum 20 hours continuous playback with ANC enabled. Physical design should feature memory foam over-ear cups and an adjustable headband for all-day comfort. Includes USB-C fast charging and a physical mute switch for the microphone. Audio tuning should prioritize voice reproduction for calls while maintaining balanced music performance.
